items.name: research-beetles-weapon-edges-1
items.refnote: the first image is the Shieldbearer: draw only the head of its war hammer, keeping its shape; not the beetle.
items.subject: WEAPON EDGES I (sharper melee weapons, the first and plainest of three levels): one heavy beetle war-hammer head alone, a block of PLAIN DARK GREY IRON with a rough hammered surface and a few iron rivets, its striking face freshly ground to a bright steel edge, angled diagonally with the bright edge toward the upper left light. No brass, no blue paint, no glass.

items.name: research-beetles-weapon-edges-2
items.subject: WEAPON EDGES II: the same hammer head, now of hardened POLISHED STEEL, bound with two bright BRASS bands and brass rivets, the striking edge honed to a mirror gleam.

items.name: research-beetles-weapon-edges-3
items.subject: WEAPON EDGES III, the masterwork: the same hammer head in polished steel with ornate brass bands and ROYAL-BLUE enamel panels, and a small window of glowing violet substance glass set into its side, the striking edge white-bright.

items.name: research-beetles-bolt-calibre-1
items.subject: BOLT CALIBRE I (ranged weapons deal more damage, the first and plainest of three levels): one single thick repeater bolt alone, a fat short shaft with a blunt conical tip and three stubby square fins, all of PLAIN DARK GREY IRON with a rough forged surface and one ring of iron rivets, angled diagonally with the tip toward the upper right. No brass, no blue paint, no glass.

items.name: research-beetles-bolt-calibre-2
items.subject: BOLT CALIBRE II: the same bolt, now with a jacket of bright polished BRASS around its shaft and fins, held by brass rivets, its tip a hardened POLISHED STEEL point honed to a gleam.

items.name: research-beetles-bolt-calibre-3
items.subject: BOLT CALIBRE III, the masterwork: the same bolt in polished steel and ornate brass with one ROYAL-BLUE enamel band around the shaft, and a small capsule of glowing violet substance glass set just behind its white-bright steel tip.

items.name: research-beetles-plating-1
items.refnote: the first image is the Shieldbearer: take only the shape of its shoulder pauldron, in plain grey iron instead of its blue paint and brass; do not draw the beetle, the shield or the hammer.
items.subject: PLATING I (troops and machines gain armour, the first and plainest of three levels): one thick curved shoulder pauldron alone, layered in two overlapping bands, of PLAIN DARK GREY IRON with a rough hammered surface and one row of plain iron rivets along its edge, angled diagonally, its curved top catching the upper left light. No brass, no blue paint, no glass.

items.name: research-beetles-plating-2
items.subject: PLATING II: the same pauldron, now of hardened POLISHED STEEL, its edges bound with bright BRASS trim and its rivets of brass.

items.name: research-beetles-plating-3
items.subject: PLATING III, the masterwork: the same pauldron in polished steel with ornate brass trim, its bands enamelled in ROYAL BLUE, and one round stud of glowing violet substance glass set in its centre.

items.name: research-beetles-riveted-hulls-1
items.refnote: the first image is the Juggernaut: take only the shape of its domed hull with the round porthole, in plain grey iron instead of its blue paint and brass; do not draw the machine, its legs or cannons.
items.subject: RIVETED HULLS I (war machines gain health, the plainer of two levels): one domed section of a war machine's round boiler hull, like a slice of a big iron sphere, with one small round porthole and two seam bands lined with big round rivets, all PLAIN DARK GREY IRON, the porthole dark. No brass, no blue paint, no glow. It is a machine's hull, not a shoulder plate.

items.name: research-beetles-riveted-hulls-2
items.subject: RIVETED HULLS II, the reinforced hull: the same domed hull section, now in polished steel with ROYAL-BLUE enamel plates riveted over it, thick brass seam bands with double rows of brass rivets, and a brass-rimmed porthole of glowing violet substance glass.

items.name: research-beetles-specialist-training-adept
items.subject: SPECIALIST TRAINING: ADEPT (the specialists learn their second abilities, the first of two levels): one heavy armoured beetle gauntlet alone, upright and angled diagonally, its thick fingers spread open as if casting, of PLAIN DARK GREY IRON with riveted knuckle plates and a broad riveted cuff. No brass, no blue paint, no glass. Only the gauntlet: no arm, no beetle.

items.name: research-beetles-specialist-training-master
items.subject: SPECIALIST TRAINING: MASTER: the same gauntlet, now the masterwork of POLISHED STEEL with bright BRASS knuckle rims and cuff, ROYAL-BLUE enamel plates on its back, and one round core of glowing violet substance glass set into its palm.

items.name: research-beetles-afterburners
items.refnote: the first image is the Steamwing: take only its dark steel, brass and royal-blue materials for the nozzle; do not draw the Steamwing or its wings.
items.subject: AFTERBURNERS (Steamwings fly faster): one flared exhaust nozzle of dark riveted steel with a thick brass rim, seen from behind at an angle and pointing to the lower left, blasting one bold cone of bright orange furnace flame with a short white steam collar around it. Only the nozzle and its jet: no wings, no machine.

items.name: research-beetles-drum-magazines
items.refnote: the first image is the Bolter: take only its brass, dark steel and royal-blue materials; do not draw the Bolter or its gun.
items.subject: DRUM MAGAZINES (Bolters attack faster): one big round drum magazine alone, a fat polished brass cylinder seen at an angle so its round face shows, a broad ROYAL-BLUE painted band around its middle, a heavy steel crank hub in the centre of its face and a short thick feed chute at its side with the blunt tips of two iron bolts showing.

items.name: research-beetles-fragmentation-shells
items.refnote: the first image is the Bombard: take only its dark iron and brass materials; do not draw the Bombard or its cannon.
items.subject: FRAGMENTATION SHELLS (mortar shells burst wider and slow the survivors): one fat round mortar shell alone, upright and tilted slightly, of dark iron cut by deep criss-cross grooves into big chunky segments ready to fly apart, a squat brass fuse cap on top glowing bright orange at its tip.

items.name: research-beetles-heavy-pistons
items.refnote: the first image is the Breacher: take only its dark steel and brass materials; do not draw the Breacher or its drill.
items.subject: HEAVY PISTONS (Breachers charge twice as often): one massive piston alone, angled diagonally: a thick polished steel rod driving out of a squat brass cylinder held by four heavy bolts, one round puff of white steam bursting from the seal where the rod leaves the cylinder.

items.name: research-beetles-interlocking-shields
items.refnote: the first image is the Shieldbearer: draw only its tower shield, twice, keeping its blue planks, brass rim, notched top and steel boss; do not draw the beetle or its hammer.
items.subject: INTERLOCKING SHIELDS (locked shields give far more armour): two tall royal-blue tower shields side by side, seen from the front at a slight angle, each with a brass rim and a round steel boss, their touching edges overlapping and gripped by two heavy brass clamps. Only the two shields: no beetles behind them.

items.name: research-beetles-pressure-mains
items.subject: PRESSURE MAINS (the substance network reaches further): one thick brass pipe junction alone, three fat pipes meeting in a riveted dark steel hub and leading away to the edges of the frame, a big brass valve wheel on top of the hub, and one short glass sight-tube in the front pipe glowing violet with substance.
